reasoning: JsTs is air (two overcards, no draw) on 8c5d2h rainbow. Both opponents checked to BTN (hero) 3-way. Betting folds out worse air but gets called by underpairs that beat hero.

KhJh is air on Ac9d3s — both overcards (K, J) are dominated by the ace already on board. Hero is OOP (SB) acting first into BTN and BB 3-way. Per DO NOT Rule #2, OOP semi-bluffs/pure bluffs into 2 opponents on an A-high board (which favors raiser's range) lose money. Check and let the hand play out cheaply.

Td9d is a non-nut flush draw + gutshot on Jd8d3h. Per KB §1.7, semi-bluff RAISE 3-way requires nut draw + blocker + side equity — Td9d fails the nut-draw criterion. With ~36-40% equity, pot odds 26.8%, and 12+ outs, calling realizes equity at correct price. Per DO NOT Rule #2, do not barrel non-nut draws into 2 opponents.

9s8s is busted air on QsJd5h2c6c river. Both opponents already checked the river. River bluffing 3-way requires nearly impossible fold equity from two opponents who have already checked back; missed OESD has zero showdown value. Standard check-give-up.

AdKs is the textbook KB §1.7 / Worked Example 9 nut-draw-with-blocker pattern: nut flush draw + Ad blocker (removes villain's nut-FD continues) + 2 overcards (6 outs to TPTK) + gutshot to broadway = ~44%+ equity plus fold equity. CO bet into 3-way represents value, but the As blocker reduces villain's continuing range and hero's combined draw equity makes raising +EV vs flat-calling. v3.4 OVERRIDE: bet-alone line with reasonable air; raise structure preferred.

Qd3d is a non-nut flush draw on Jd8d4c — explicitly fails the KB §1.7 nut-draw criterion (no Ad blocker, no side equity). Per DO NOT Rule #2, non-nut draws 3-way must call/check, not semi-bluff. Pot odds 26.8% with 9 outs (~36% by river) is a clear price-meeting CALL.

Tc9c is the flopped nut straight (the absolute nuts) on QhJs8d. Per Worked Example 4, monsters MUST bet 3-way — slowplaying a flopped nut on a board with redraws (one-card straight draws K/9, FD redraws on turn) lets two opponents draw out for free. Bet 50-66% pot for value and protection from two villains' equity.

QhJc is TPGK on Qc8d3s dry rainbow. IP, both opponents checked to hero showing weakness. Dry static board with high villain air typical (CO opened, BB defended a board that misses both ranges) supports thin value extraction. Bet small (25-33%) targets worse Qx, pocket pairs, and folds out air's overcard equity.

QsJd TPGK OOP first to act 3-way on Qc8d3s. Position amplification axis: same hand as MW-23 IP becomes a pot-control hand OOP. Betting first into BTN and BB without seeing checks risks getting raised by sets/2pair, called by better Qx, and offers no positional advantage to extract on later streets. Check-call line preserves showdown value and avoids inflating pot OOP with medium-strength hand.

JhJc overpair on 9d6c2h dry rainbow, IP, both opponents checked. Overpair to a low dry rainbow board where villain's continuing range is composed mostly of underpairs, overcards, and gutshots. Bet small (25-33%) for thin value from 88/77/66, denies overcard equity (Ax, Kx, Qx), and protects against runner-runner draws.

JhJd overpair OOP first to act on 9d6c2h 3-way. Position amplification axis: OOP overpair into two live villains defaults toward pot control even on dry boards because hero cannot evaluate later streets with information advantage. Worse pairs (88-22) rarely call OOP bets here, while better hands (sets, AA-QQ in BTN's flat range) keep going. Check, plan to check-call modest sizing.

KcTh top pair on KdJc6s facing CO bet + BTN call. Reversal anchor (solver-corrected): raw equity ~40% vs pot odds 18.4% — the equity surplus (>20pp margin) is too large to fold despite the bet-and-call narrowing signal. Per KB §1.9 / Example 3, BTN's continuing range is ~32% TP+ with significant weaker holdings KT dominates (worse Kx, middle pairs). Equity surplus + composition triple makes this a pure CALL.

8h8s is a flopped middle set on 8d7c3h facing CO bet + BTN call 3-way. Reversal anchor: sets MUST raise vs bet-and-call for value extraction and protection on a connected board (turn cards 4/5/6/9/T all bring straights or two-pair improvements). The bet-and-call signal narrows villain ranges to value, which is exactly what hero wants to extract from. Raising builds pot, charges draws/2pair, and isolates.

AcAd overpair on Js9c4d dry rainbow, hero is PFA (CO open), BB checked, hero acts before BTN. Per KB §1.3, default sizing 25-33% pot. AA dominates villain ranges on this dry board, needs to deny equity from BB's overcards (KQ, KJ, QT) and BTN's middle pocket pairs (TT, 99, 88). Small c-bet builds pot and protects.

QcJd TPGK on Qh7c2s dry rainbow at compressed SPR ~3 facing CO bet 3-way, BTN behind. Pot odds 25%, equity ~50-55% — clear price-meeting call with TPGK. Low SPR commits stacks; calling preserves option to play turn vs CO + BTN. Raising over-isolates and balloons pot OOP-equivalent with a medium-strength hand against a CO range that contains AQ/KQ/sets that beat hero.

Same QcJd TPGK on Qh7c2s, standard SPR ~8, facing CO bet 33 into 90 3-way with BTN behind. Pot odds 26.8%, equity ~50% with worse pairs/draws in CO's range that hero beats. CALL preserves position vs BTN closing action and lets hero realize equity. BTN's cold-call preflop range on this dry Q-high flop is air-heavy + middle pairs; BTN's continuing decision narrows ranges.

QcJd TPGK on Qh7c2s deep SPR ~15 facing CO bet 3-way. Pot odds 25%, equity ~50%. Deep SPR introduces more reverse implied odds risk vs sets/AQ but hero still has clear price-meeting equity with TPGK on a dry rainbow. CALL and play turn cautiously; folding TPGK at 25% pot odds gives up too much vs CO's wide cbet range.

AhJh nut flush draw + nut blocker + overcard outs on Kh8h3d two-tone, low SPR ~3 facing BB donk lead 3-way (CO behind). BB's donk represents a polarized strong/draw range with very low air; KB §1.7 / v3.4 OVERRIDE check: villain_air on a donk lead is minimal, raise EV from fold equity is thin, and CO is still to act behind hero (sandwich risk). CALL preserves equity realization and avoids committing 30bb stack with no fold equity vs BB's value.

AhJh nut flush draw + Ah blocker on Kh8h3d, high SPR ~15 facing CO bet 3-way. Empirically motivated v3.2 OVERRIDE anchor: villain_air on this CO c-bet line is ~0.05 — well below the 0.20 fold-equity threshold for KB §1.7 RAISE. Without genuine fold equity, the nut blocker's raise EV collapses; CALL realizes 9-out FD equity + overcard outs at a price hero meets. Reversal-set anchor.

QhTc on KsQd7c-Jh turn = second pair (Q, under K) + open-ended straight draw (any 9 or A makes the straight, 8 outs) facing CO 30% turn barrel 3-way. Pot odds 23.1%, equity ~33-36% from clean outs + showdown value; aggression narrows villain's range but draw outs survive narrowing. CALL.

Th8h on Ts9h4d-7c = top pair + open-ended straight draw (J or 6 makes straight, 8 outs) facing BB double lead 70 into 180 3-way. ~50%+ equity (TP + 8-out OESD), pot odds 28%. BB's donk-and-barrel line represents value (2pair, sets, made straights) but hero's combined made-hand + straight equity comfortably calls. Raise risks getting 3-bet by 2pair+; flat preserves implied odds when straight comes.

AhTc gutshot (only 4 outs to broadway) + 2 overcards on QdJc4s low SPR ~2 OOP BB 3-way, hero first to act. Low SPR compresses bluff frequency (DO NOT Rule #2 doubly applies — 3-way fold equity ~36% on a board that hits raiser's range, plus low SPR offers no street-tree maneuver). With marginal made/draw equity and no positional info, check and play check-call/check-fold based on action.

AdKd TPTK on As9c5d-Tc, IP BTN after both opponents check turn. Hero already bet flop and got bet-call-call from CO+BB; turn brings T (straight only with KJ/J9 — 1-card draw). Both checking turn signals weakness; TPTK with the top kicker dominates worse Ax in CO's flat range and BB's defended Ax. Standard turn barrel for value/protection at compressed SPR — bet 33-50% pot.

JcTc top pair on Js8h4d-5c facing BTN turn bet after BTN raised flop and BB just called. Action history (raise + barrel) overrides equity here — pure fold despite ~29% pot odds.

QcJc top pair on 2s5dJd two-tone flop, BB OOP with both villains having checked through preflop + flop opening to hero (compressed SPR 1.25). v3.4 Calibration Notes anchor: BET small (25-33%) preferred in solver 50/50 mix.
